text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 08 · 临海长桌与凉廊.
Environment:  An empty intimate Mediterranean dining pergola above the sea, cream stone columns and light oak slat canopy with translucent ivory fabric diffusing the light. A long warm-brown table offset left, modest ceramic dishes, folded linen napkins and a glass water carafe, mismatched woven chairs. Pale gravel garden and olive tree to right; wide gap at center gives view to the sea and low coastal hills. Soft bright summer light, shallow low-contrast stripes only, tactile everyday luxury, no elaborate banquet excess.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 4 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 08 · 临海长桌与凉廊. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. A 2x2 sheet of FOUR distinct eye-level camera views of the SAME ONE space: original forward direction, a lateral oblique view, a reverse view 180 degrees opposite, and the other lateral view. Labels A B C D only. Preserve ALL door/window/furniture positions; actually move camera, never mirror the building. Same material and lighting. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
